title: Design System: The Driving School Dublin

display.purpose: The page headline, one per page. Page intros use clamp(48px, 13vw, 96px).

numeral.purpose: Prices on tiles; the same heavy tabular treatment scales down for row prices, dates, counters and the rating score.

quote.purpose: Review carousel; key phrase underlined in red.

item.purpose: Names in ruled rows, FAQ questions, step titles.

lede.purpose: Line under a page headline, 19px from 768px, max 36ch.

body.purpose: Descriptions in grey 600; long prose at 17px / 1.65, 62ch.

label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, nav links, tabs.

shadows.name: plate
shadows.purpose: The L and N plates, lifted off the page.

shadows.name: result-mark
shadows.purpose: Result mark plate on confirmation and EDT screens.

shadows.name: floating-nav
shadows.purpose: Nav once it becomes a floating plate.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Input focus, with an ink border.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State changes: buttons, nav morph, tile flip, FAQ, carousel.

motion.name: ease-land
motion.purpose: Objects landing: plate on, plate turn, action bar slide-up, carousel dot.

motion.name: plate-on
motion.purpose: Hero plate lands; result mark uses 700ms.

motion.name: plate-turn
motion.value: 1100ms, or scroll-linked on view() entry 10% to contain 35%
motion.purpose: L turns to N at the close.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes transforms and blur, shows final states, keeps only short opacity fades.

components.css: .ds-days { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 96px); gap: 8px; } .ds-day { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 92px; padding: 14px 6px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; background: #fff; color: #0A0A0A; border: 2px solid #3F7A52; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-day:hover { background: #EDF4EF; } .ds-day:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-day:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #C8102E; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-dow { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3F7A52; } .ds-num { font-weight: 900; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-day[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #C8102E; border-color: #C8102E; color: #fff; } .ds-day[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-dow { color: #FFE3E7; } .ds-day-full { background: #F4F4F4; border-color: #E9E9E9; color: #5C5C5C; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-day-full:hover { background: #F4F4F4; } .ds-day-full .ds-dow { color: #5C5C5C; }

narrative.overview:
The site speaks the logo's language: a heavy, slightly condensed black grotesque on white, and the red learner plate. The plate is the recurring object. It sits tilted beside the hero headline as an L, and at the close of the homepage it turns into an N as the page scrolls toward booking. Every screen, from the marketing pages to the booking flow, the EDT package link and the admin dashboard, is built from the same few materials: white paper, 2px ink rules, square plate tiles, and a single red that is spent sparingly.

Density is plain and confident. Structure comes from horizontal 2px black rules rather than cards: price rows, steps, FAQ, reviews, contact options and booking services are all ruled lists. Numbers are the interface; prices, ratings, counters and dates are set huge, heavy and tabular. One full-black band per page carries the credential, and nothing else is allowed that weight.

Motion is physical and short: things land, flip and slide as if they were plates being handled. Every animation has a `prefers-reduced-motion` path that either removes it or ends it in its final state.
keyCharacteristics: Red, black, white and neutral greys only; muted functional status tones are the single exception.
Archivo variable, 800 to 900 and condensed on the width axis for display; 400 to 600 for text.
2px ink rules as the structural line; ruled lists over boxed cards.
The learner plate (white square, 2px ink border, red letter, soft drop shadow) as the signature object.
One red fill per view; one black field per page.
Tabular, heavy numerals for every price, rating and count.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red fills exactly one button, tile or selection per view. Where two would meet, the second steps down to ink: the nav's Book button is ink (red only on hover), and on phones the closing Book button is ink because the mobile action bar already carries the red. Red text accents (plate letters, stars, underlines) do not count against the fill.

rules.name: The Black Field Rule
rules.body: One full-bleed black band per page, reserved for the credential. Ink may fill small controls and markers, never a second section.

rules.name: The Muted Status Rule
rules.body: Status colours are desaturated and never used decoratively. Brand red is never a status colour for "available"; it means "yours".

rules.name: The Numbers Are the Interface Rule
rules.body: Every price, rating, count, date and time uses tabular lining numerals and is set heavier and larger than the words around it.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, labels and buttons are sentence case. Uppercase is used only for three-letter day and month abbreviations inside calendar cells.

rules.name: The Lifted Object Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the thing is an object in hand (a plate, a floating bar). Panels, tiles, rows and cards never carry one.

dos: **Do** build structure from 2px ink rules (`2px solid #0A0A0A`) and ruled lists before reaching for a boxed card.
**Do** spend plate red (#C8102E) on one fill per view and step any second primary down to ink.
**Do** set every price, rating, count, date and time in 900 Archivo with tabular lining numerals.
**Do** keep radii to the 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 / 12px ladder and borders at 2px.
**Do** give every animation a `prefers-reduced-motion` path and keep hover effects inside `(hover: hover)`.
**Do** use the stock Tailwind names on Tailwind-styled screens so the root remap brings them onto the brand.
donts: **Don't** introduce a new accent, a second brand colour or a gradient colour field; red, black, white and greys only, plus muted status tones.
**Don't** add a second full-black section to a page; the band belongs to the credential.
**Don't** use pill-shaped buttons or chips; tags are 4px squares and buttons 8px.
**Don't** put shadows on tiles, panels, rows or cards, and never use hard offset shadows.
**Don't** set small uppercase tracked labels above headings; headings stand on their own.
**Don't** use text glyphs as icons; icons are inline SVG in one 2px stroke family with square caps.
**Don't** use a serif or system display face; Archivo carries every role.
